params.name: active
params.description: Filter for effectively active mailboxes (marked active with a live subscription)

params.name: email_addresses
params.description: Email addresses of the mailboxes to return (comma-delimited)

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of entries to return. If the value exceeds the maximum, then the maximum value will be used

params.name: mailbox_types
params.description: Comma-delimited list of mailbox types to filter by

params.name: message_source_id
params.description: ID of the message source the mailboxes belong to

params.name: offset
params.description: The (zero-based) offset of the first mailbox to return

params.name: search
params.description: Search across mailbox names and email addresses

params.name: sub_error_types
params.description: Comma-delimited list of subscription error types to filter by
